design_archetype: The Performance Pro / Editorial Technical Precision (Adobe Pro Tool Aesthetic)
emotional_tone: Precise, reliable, technical, industrial, authoritative, frictionless
theme: Dark Mode Default (Deep Obsidian #090A0F, Graphite Slate #12151E, Kinetic Amber Accent #F59E0B / Solar Flame #FF6B00)

typography.font_loading_instructions: Import Outfit, Manrope, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts in index.html or index.css (@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;500;700&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Outfit:wght@500;600;700;800;900&display=swap');)

layout_and_navigation.marketing_header: Sticky glassmorphism header with logo ('Saturn'), links (Features, How it Works, Pricing, FAQ), and CTA button ('Launch Converter') routing to /app with data-testid='nav-launch-app-button'
layout_and_navigation.marketing_footer: High density technical footer with newsletter subscription, quick links, AE version support list, and copyright notice
layout_and_navigation.app_shell: Sidebar navigation + Top status bar + Main panel architecture
layout_and_navigation.two_pane_converter: Left Pane: Drag-and-drop zone (.ffx, .xml, .json, batch) + File info + Target AE version/OS selectors + Safe Conversion toggle + Analyze action button. Right Pane: Live compatibility report drawer (compatible, flagged expressions/effects, fallbacks, manual TODOs) + Package download action button.

key_components.drag_drop_uploader: Interactive upload dropzone with drag hover glow, file list with badge indicators (.ffx / .xml / .json), batch removal, and sample preset loader buttons ('Load Sample Glow.ffx', 'Load Complex Camera Rig')
key_components.ae_version_target_picker: Dropdowns for Source AE Version (auto-detected or override CS6-2025), Target AE Version (CS6, CC2014, CC2018, CC2020, 2022, 2024, 2025), and OS Target (macOS / Windows)
key_components.compatibility_report_panel: Categorized tabs: All (count), Compatible (green check), Flagged (amber warning for missing plugins/expressions), Fallbacks (blue info), Manual TODOs (red fix needed). Includes diff viewer for expressions/keyframes
key_components.package_downloader: Action card that generates and downloads a zipped compatibility package containing modified preset XML/FFX, compatibility report JSON, and AE version setup script
key_components.first_run_modal: Setup modal prompting user to select preferred AE versions, default OS, and safe expression fallback mode on first app launch
key_components.preset_library_grid: Grid of saved/favorite motion presets with search, tag filters (Keyframes, Expressions, Text Animation, Color Grade, Camera), version compatibility badges, and one-click convert/export
key_components.conversion_history_timeline: Chronological history table/timeline of previous batch conversions with status indicators, execution time, target versions, and re-download links
key_components.rules_panel: JSON/YAML rule browser showing how Saturn converts expression functions (e.g. linear(), wiggle(), loopOut(), Universal English Expression conversion) across AE versions

instructions_to_main_agent: Use React + Tailwind CSS + Lucide React icons for the entire frontend (ensure JavaScript .js / .jsx files are used).
Implement both the Marketing Landing Page ('/') and the Converter SaaS Web App ('/app') inside the React router.
Make the converter fully functional on the frontend with rich mock analysis algorithms and FastAPI backend integration (/api/convert, /api/presets, /api/rules, /api/history).
Clear labeling: Ensure UI explicitly states 'Analyzes & generates compatibility package' so users know it provides truthful, precise AE preset migration and expression remapping.

Provide interactive sample presets (e.g., '3D Camera Shake.ffx', 'Text Typewriter + Wiggle.json', 'Universal Glitch Rig.xml') so users can immediately click and test conversion without uploading their own files.

Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, cards, modals) have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='preset-upload-dropzone', data-testid='convert-now-button', data-testid='download-package-button').
Maintain strict design contrast: High contrast text on dark backgrounds, vibrant amber primary buttons, precise 1px borders, crisp JetBrains Mono tags and expression code snippets.
Include responsive layout adjustments for mobile/tablet while keeping desktop layout as a high-density, dual-pane pro tool workspace.
universal_guidelines: DO NOT use Inter or Space Grotesk for headings. Use Outfit or Cabinet Grotesk for headings and JetBrains Mono for code.
DO NOT use full-screen purple gradients on white. Keep a dark obsidian slate aesthetic with amber accents.
Add generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) inside bordered containers to avoid text colliding with edges.
Ensure all hover states explicitly define text colors (e.g. hover:bg-amber-500 hover:text-slate-950).
Ensure all toast notifications use Sonner with dark styled toasts.
Include data-testid on every interactive button, input, tab, link, and modal.
